problems: duchy-of-wroc-aw is not a dossier: its three Cliopatria shapes (Upper Silesia, 1169-1201) are reviewed inside duchy-of-silesia. The orchestrator should not expect history/polities/duchy-of-wroc-aw.json and the colour agent should treat the slug as an alias of duchy-of-silesia.

Cliopatria draws the Piast Seniorate (Kraków) under whichever duchy's name the High Duke held: the Sandomierz, Silesia, Greater Poland, Masovia and Opole dossiers must agree on the Kraków hand-over years (see notes).

Source count: 23 entries over 19 distinct pages (Testament of Bolesław III, Casimir II, Henry I and Bolesław V are cited by both Sandomierz and Silesia). Sandomierz opened 10 pages against a budget of 9; Silesia 11 against 9 + 2 (two are aliases).
WebFetch returns a model summary of each page, not raw text: the quotes in notes are the summary's quotations, not checked against the wikitext.
Dossiers end at Cliopatria's last year (Sandomierz 1304, Silesia 1304, Pomerania 1187) although the pages run the states on (1320, 1335, 1637); see gaps.
